title: Testronic 扩大高级管理团队，Mike Guttman 出任高级合作副总裁
content:
Testronic expands senior leadership, Mike Guttman appointed vice president of senior partnerships | GamesIndustry.biz

.
Testronic has made several senior appointments across its global locations, including Mike Guttman as vice president of senior partnerships.
Guttman previously served as a client partner at Keywords Studios and as a senior business development manager.
Nicole Closson joins Guttman as business development manager to "further enhance commercial coverage and support partners in the region and worldwide."
Mike Guttman
Closson previously worked at Keywords Studios as an enterprise account executive and at Unity as senior account executive for Parsec and SyncSketch.
In Warsaw, Mateusz Kałuża has been appointed QA director after holding senior testing roles at Lionbridge Games.
"Warsaw brings together deep QA expertise, experience and a real understanding of what developers need from a testing partner," said Kałuża. "Our continued investment in the team ensures we grow that expertise locally, fully connect it with Testronic's wider global capabilities and deliver consistently for partners wherever they are based."
Lily Guerreiro also joins as global partnerships senior manager, having previously served as global business development manager at Keywords Studios.
Testronic's Centre of Excellence in Manila has also received senior appointments, with Daniel Bowie Soriano joining as senior QA manager alongside Ivan Balanay as QA trainer.
Testronic stated that Balanay's appointment "further supports [its] investment in developing the Testronic Academy and building the next generation of QA expertise."
"Our Centres of Excellence bring together talented people, specialist expertise and leadership, and connect those capabilities across a genuinely global organisation," said CRO Michael Fitzgerald.
"The investments we are making in New Orleans, Warsaw and Manila, alongside our presence in London, further strengthen the expertise available to our partners. By continuing to invest in outstanding people, we can deliver an exceptional Player-Focused, Partner-First and Outcomes-Led service to our clients."
Earlier this month,
Testronic appointed Sonia Kerr as CEO
, succeeding
Sharon Baylay-Bell
who became company chair.
Fitzgerald was also announced as CRO alongside Samantha Williams as CCO. Fitzgerald was a client partner at Keywords Studios, while Williams was Testronic's global CRO and head of Europe.
